tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
– Fast & Portable 64GB USB 3.2 Flash Drive


Upgrade your portable storage with the Apacer AH356 64GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive — a compact and reliable USB thumb drive ideal for storing documents, photos, videos, and more. Designed with USB 3.2 Gen 1 high-speed performance and a sleek slide-to-connect design, it’s a perfect everyday storage solution. Available now at competitive prices in Bangladesh from OTECH BD.


Key Features


  • 64GB Storage Capacity – Plenty of space for everyday files and multimedia
  • USB 3.2 Gen 1 Interface – Faster file transfer up to 5Gbps (backward compatible with USB 2.0)
  • USB Type-A Connector – Easy to use with laptops, desktops, TVs & car systems
  • Slide-to-Connect Design – No cap to lose; protects the USB connector
  • Plug & Play – Simple and ready to use with Windows, macOS & Linux
  • Portable & Lightweight – Easy to carry for travel, school, or work
